title: Actual exam question for Salesforce's Plat-Arch-203 exam
question: Which three are capabilities of SAML-based Federated authentication? Choose 3 answers
option_A: Access tokens are used to access resources on the server once the user is authenticated.
option_B: Trust relationships between Identity Provider and Service Provider are required.
option_C: SAML tokens can be in XML or JSON format and can be used interchangeably.
option_D: Centralized federation provides single point of access, control and auditing.
option_E: Web applications with no passwords are more secure and stronger against attacks.

title: Actual exam question for Salesforce's Plat-Arch-203 exam
question:
Users logging into Salesforce are frequently prompted to verify their identity.
The identity architect is required to provide recommendations so that frequency of prompt verification can be reduced.
What should the identity architect recommend to meet the requirement?
option_A: Set trusted IP ranges for the organization.
option_B: Implement 2FA authentication for the Salesforce org.
option_C: Implement an single sign-on for Salesforce using an external identity provider.
option_D: Implement multi-factor authentication for the Salesforce org.

title: Actual exam question for Salesforce's Plat-Arch-203 exam
question:
A global company's Salesforce Identity Architect is reviewing its Salesforce production org login history and is seeing some intermittent Security Assertion Markup Language (SAML SSO) 'Replay Detected and Assertion Invalid' login errors.
Which two issues would cause these errors?
Choose 2 answers
option_A: The assertion sent to 5alesforce contains an assertion ID previously used.
option_B: The subject element is missing from the assertion sent to salesforce.
option_C: The current time setting of the company's identity provider (IdP) and Salesforce platform is out of sync by more than eight minutes.
option_D: The certificate loaded into SSO configuration does not match the certificate used by the IdP.
